title: Some hits and Some misses
text:
I have received two shipments of the Blue Sampler Box.

The Genmaicha will make people leave the house it smells so bad. One reviewer thought the white particles were Styrofoam - I don't. I think that some of the rice grains popped while being toasted. The Blood Orange is both funky and viscous - not a hit in my house, either.

The Formosa Oolong is quite enjoyable. I really like that tea...but for some reason you can't find it on their website.

Lastly, except for the cardboard box, all the packaging looks quite different from what is displayed on Amazon - the tea bags are said to be of linen, but they look like a polyester. The teas are all packaged in pretty and colorful little resealable plastic bags.

I don't know how often they duplicate something that has previously been sent with these samplers, and I really do not want to get more Genmaicha or Blood Orange tea. I looked for a way to make some pre-selections for the Blue Box sampler, but did not find one.

I will try a few more of the teas before I decide, but it is likely that I will cancel the Blue Sampler.

This product is overall a good idea, but unevenly implemented for me.
label: neutral
